method: Supplementary tables of open-access paralog-pair studies, downloaded from the publishers' static file servers and searched for NABP1/NABP2/AGPAT1/AGPAT2 (and aliases). Parrish et al. 2021 (Cell Rep) could not be downloaded (NCBI bot check); Ito 2021, Koferle 2022 and De Kegel 2021 (Cell Syst) are not open access.
sources_checked: Dede et al. 2020 Genome Biol (PMC7558751) Tables S1-S2
Thompson et al. 2021 Nat Commun (PMC7910459) Supplementary Data 1-8
Esmaeili Anvar et al. 2024 Nat Commun, in4mer (PMC11055879) Supplementary Data 1-10

NABP1 -> NABP2: Computationally predicted: De Kegel et al. 2019 PLoS Genet Supplementary Table 5 (as listed in Thompson 2021 Supplementary Data 7); Dede 2020 Table S1, Broad: odds ratio 651, FDR 1.6e-10.

Experimentally screened in in4mer 2024 (Supplementary Data 7): NABP1+NABP2 double knockout log fold change -2.00 (Meljuso) and -2.68 (A375) vs single knockouts -0.24/-0.19 (NABP1) and 0.23/0.10 (NABP2); not measured in K562/A549. Their genetic-interaction summary (Supplementary Data 8) did not call it (fdr_synth 0.95); not reconciled here.
Not screened by Thompson 2021 or Gonatopoulos-Pournatzis 2020.
AGPAT2 -> AGPAT1: Computationally predicted: De Kegel et al. 2019 Supplementary Table 5; Dede 2020 Table S1, Broad FDR 1.7e-6 and Sanger FDR 1.4e-3 (AGPAT2 alteration -> AGPAT1 essential).
in4mer 2024: double knockout -1.69 in Meljuso (singles -0.58/-1.39), near zero elsewhere; no synthetic call.
Not screened by Thompson 2021 or Gonatopoulos-Pournatzis 2020.

verdict: Neither is novel as a computational observation: both were predicted from earlier DepMap data in 2019-2020. What this project adds is independent evidence: replication in held-out and independent-Sanger lines, prospectively in Cas12-screened lines first screened after 24Q4 (NABP2), and under RNAi (both).
